# PurpleHere - Cloud POS System
> Subscription-based Point of Sale system for restaurants, brands, and food courts

## What is PurpleHere?

PurpleHere is a cloud-based POS (Point of Sale) system designed specifically for the food service industry. It provides real-time order management, inventory tracking, and multi-location support for restaurants, food court operators, and franchise brands.

## Key Facts

- **Product Type**: Cloud-based SaaS POS system
- **Target Users**: Restaurants, food courts, franchise brands
- **Pricing Model**: Subscription-based (monthly/annual)
- **Free Trial**: 7 days, no credit card required
- **Deployment**: 100% cloud-based, accessible via web browser

## Core Features

### For Restaurants
- POS Terminal with real-time order processing
- Menu management with categories, options, and modifiers
- Kitchen Display System (KDS) for order tracking
- Customer-facing display for order confirmation
- Table management and dine-in/takeaway support
- Staff management with role-based access
- Reports and analytics dashboard

### For Brands (Franchise)
- Multi-location management from single dashboard
- Centralized menu control across all branches
- Brand-wide inventory tracking
- Consolidated reporting and analytics
- Recipe and cost management
- Supplier management

### For Food Courts
- Multiple tenant management
- Centralized payment processing
- Shared customer display systems
- Cross-tenant reporting

## Pricing Plans

### Restaurant Plans
- **Basic**: For small restaurants starting out
- **Professional**: For growing restaurants (Most Popular)
- **Enterprise**: For large-scale operations with unlimited usage

### Brand Plans
- Multi-location management
- Centralized control
- Custom pricing based on number of locations

### Food Court Plans
- Multi-tenant support
- Custom pricing based on requirements

## Technical Specifications

- **Platform**: Web-based (works on any modern browser)
- **Mobile Support**: Responsive design for tablets and mobile
- **API**: RESTful API for integrations
- **Security**: HTTPS, JWT authentication, role-based access control
- **Data**: Real-time sync across all devices

## Common Questions

Q: How long is the free trial?
A: 7 days with full access to all features. No credit card required.

Q: What payment methods are accepted?
A: Bank transfer. Credit card and PayPal coming soon.

Q: Can I change plans later?
A: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time.

Q: Is there a setup fee?
A: No setup fees. You only pay the subscription fee.

Q: Do you offer custom plans?
A: Yes, Enterprise plans are fully customizable. Contact us for a quote.

Q: What devices are supported?
A: Any device with a modern web browser - desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

Q: Is my data secure?
A: Yes, we use industry-standard security including HTTPS encryption, secure authentication, and regular backups.

Q: Can I integrate with other systems?
A: We provide API access for integrations. Contact us for specific integration requirements.
